sub_answers.text: DeMont had his 1972 Olympic gold medal stripped after a post-race urinalysis tested positive for ephedrine contained in his prescription asthma medication [d36836906s4p0]. The United States Olympic Committee recognized his gold medal performance in 2001, but the International Olympic Committee has refused to restore the medal as of 2017 [d36836906s4p0].

sub_answers.text: She won gold in the 50-metre freestyle and was a member of gold-medal 4×100-metre freestyle and 4×100-metre medley relay teams (and silver in the 4×200-metre freestyle relay) at the 2005 World Aquatics Championships [d901542s4p0]. She recorded a then fourth-fastest-ever 200-metre freestyle lead-off split of 1:57.06 in that meet and finished 2005 ranked number one in the world in both the 100-metre and 200-metre freestyle [d901542s4p0]. She lowered the 100-metre short-course freestyle world record to 51.70 on consecutive nights at the Australian Short Course Championships in 2005 and set a short-course 200-metre freestyle world record of 1:53.29 on 19 November 2005, later regaining the long-course 100-metre freestyle world record on 31 January 2006 and again on 27 March 2008 with a time of 52.88 [d901542s4p0].

sub_answers.text: Relays permit the second, third or fourth swimmer to be in contact with the platform while the incoming teammate is touching the wall, and the starting swimmer may already be in motion, saving about 0.6–1.0 seconds compared to a regular start [d182796s1p0]. Relay performances are frequently faster than individual swims partly because many swimmers perform better in a team atmosphere, producing relay times typically 2–3 seconds faster than the sum of individual bests [d182796s1p0].
